title: Run Tadu doctor on every
notes: commit through the existing Lefthook configuration, with fail-closed
installation guidance and isolated synthetic hook coverage.
result: Added the no-glob tadu-doctor pre-commit command, actionable missing-CLI installation guidance and contributor PATH instructions. Existing hooks are preserved. Synthetic fixtures use the actual configuration with a staged TypeScript file, fake Tadu exits 0 and 7, a missing CLI and a trap for unrelated jobs; fixture content remains unchanged and no Git hook is installed. Git and Lefthook environment overrides are stripped from every child; system/global Git configuration is disabled and a sibling index sentinel remains byte-identical.
evidence: pnpm exec vitest run src/tooling/lefthook.test.ts --maxWorkers=1: 3 passed (all 3 failed before the hook existed); targeted ESLint and pnpm run type-check pass. tadu doctor . and git diff --check pass. No administration CLI, production operation or package install was executed. Final `pnpm check:ci` exited 0: 788 files and 1843 tests passed with coverage, plus lint, types, formatting, duplication and Knip checks. Knip retains its existing xmlsec1 binary warning and redundant-entry hint. The actual selected local Lefthook tadu-doctor job also exited 0.
